name: Latchkey
summary: A smart door lock with a backlit PIN pad whose bolt slides back as the door swings open
about: A front door close-up with a graphite smart lock: six PIN dots, a status ring and a backlit keypad. The right PIN turns the ring green, slides the dead bolt back, presses the lever and swings the door open onto a warm room. Three wrong PINs lock the keypad for 15 seconds with a countdown in the ring.
how: Tap the keypad, type on your keyboard or paste the guest PIN shown below the door
Each digit shows for a moment, then turns into a glowing dot; backspace, Clear and the arrow keys edit it
After the sixth digit the ring sweeps while the PIN is checked
A right PIN unbolts and opens the door with warm light spilling out; Lock the door closes it again
Wrong PINs shake the lock in red, and after three the keypad waits 15 seconds
